editorial:
Set during the Civil War, this historical drama follows Newt Knight, a Mississippi farmer who serves as a medic for the Confederate Army. When his nephew dies in battle, Newt heads home to protect his family but gets branded a deserter. Forced to hide in the swamps, he teams up with runaway slaves and other farmers to fight back against the Confederacy. The movie has a gritty, grounded feel that pulls you into the harsh realities of war and survival. Matthew McConaughey carries the film with a strong, steady performance that makes you root for Newt from start to finish.

The action scenes are intense and well-shot, and the story shines a light on a lesser-known piece of American history. On the downside, the pacing drags in the middle, and the movie tries to cover too much ground, which can feel overwhelming. Still, if you enjoy historical dramas with real stakes and strong characters, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Newt Knight's rebellion succeeds in taking control of Jones County, but the victory is short-lived as the Confederacy eventually regains power. The movie then jumps forward to Reconstruction, showing how freed slaves still face oppression. A twist reveals that Newt later marries a former slave, Rachel, and their mixed-race descendants face legal battles over their identity. The story ends on a bittersweet note, reminding you that freedom was only the beginning of a long struggle.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves historical dramas based on true stories.
